title: Downtown Dinner Tour Explore Denvers Culinary Scene
includes: Award-winning Locally-made Small Batch Ice Cream
Roasted Pork Belly Tacos on Blue Corn Tortilla
Tequila Margarita with Fresh Squeezed Lime Juice and Agave
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Discover Denver’s vibrant dinner scene on this engaging 2.5-hour tour. Start at the iconic Union Station and venture to four award-winning restaurants, indulging in six tastings paired with three craft cocktails or mocktails. Enjoy dishes like carnitas tacos, housemade focaccia, and a delightful gelato dessert while soaking in the atmosphere of historic neighborhoods like LoDo and the Dairy Block. This tour is designed for food lovers seeking to connect over a shared passion for culinary delights in small groups.

- 2.5-hour progressive dinner tour with 6 tastings and 3 drinks 
- Explore iconic spots like Union Station and Coors Field 
- Led by a friendly local foodie guide with personalized recommendations 
- Small groups of up to 10 ensure an intimate dining experience
